status: data-contract; requires reviewed annotations before use

required_fields.source_groups: unique factual/source group identifiers, disjoint across splits
required_fields.token_ids: body tokens only; document open/close markers are not included

semantic_spans.difficulty: explicit easy, medium, or hard label; never inferred

boundary_rules.open: Only the actual document opening marker is present when the prefix starts at body offset zero; interior prefixes receive no synthetic open marker.
boundary_rules.close: Only include the actual document closing marker when the annotated span reaches the document end and fits within generated capacity.
boundary_rules.hard_cap: A target cut by capacity is marked hard_cap_truncated and has no positive stop label at the cap.
boundary_rules.stop: A real close is a positive stop target at its source-aligned position; interior spans have no stop target; positions after a generated stop are masked.

greedy_objective.matched_crisp_control: Teacher-force the same gold target tokens from the same initial prefix with the backbone path to measure gold-history continuation quality at matched offsets.
greedy_objective.greedy_history: Run the sketch rollout autoregressively and condition subsequent generated states on the actual generated sketch inputs.
greedy_objective.gold_targets: At each generated valid position, compare to the raw gold next-token target at the same source offset.
greedy_objective.interpretation: Gold targets remain source-aligned, but after the first divergent generated input their conditioning history differs from the crisp teacher-forced control. This objective does not claim original-context continuation equivalence.
